summary: HUTCHMED (China) Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the poll results of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) held on May 12, 2026. All ordinary and special resolutions were passed, including the adoption of financial statements, re-election of directors, re-appointment of auditors, and approval of mandates to issue/repurchase shares and a 2026 Share Option Scheme. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situations event; it does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or other extraordinary corporate action.
